answer: Farming becomes a jade bet on surviving 54 epochs of grading, and every vine settlement recomputes the pearl schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 54 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 30 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
